Contract Investing Made Easy

FundLedger helps you organize contract funding, record payments, monitor remaining receivables, and understand contract performance from one clear dashboard.

Data Encryption

Your financial data is encrypted before cloud storage. Your encryption key is synchronized privately to your signed-in account so a new device can restore access after sign-in. Signed-in devices also receive encrypted FundLedger updates in real time.

Protected

App Data

Your contracts and payments are encrypted on this device before cloud storage. Aggregate traffic analytics is stored separately and does not contain your contract or payment details.
